{{- /* Page content as Markdown, with shortcodes rendered and site links made absolute. */ -}} {{- $body := .RenderShortcodes -}} {{- $rel := "" | relURL -}} {{- $abs := "" | absURL -}} {{- $body = replace $body (printf "](%s" $rel) (printf "](%s" $abs) -}} {{- $body = replace $body (printf "href=\"%s" $rel) (printf "href=\"%s" $abs) -}} {{- $body = replace $body (printf "src=\"%s" $rel) (printf "src=\"%s" $abs) -}} {{- return $body -}}
